local_copy.anchor: Genuine original PDF; version/date discrepancy retained

supported_claims: Definition2.1 assumes a fixed linear Gaussian target mechanism with iid innovations; causal interpretation requires additional structural independence.
Proposition2.4 bounds false included parents by a subset guarantee if the relevant tests have level alpha; it is not full-graph/effect coverage.
Propositions3.1 and6.1 describe level as Monte CarloB tends to infinity; Section6 fixes a sufficient lag order and warns about post-selection.
Remark3.2 calls nonlinear/non-Gaussian residual permutation heuristic; Section6 targets instantaneous parents after adding all variable lags.
Heterogeneity in predictor mechanisms can provide power while the target mechanism is held fixed.

inspected_anchors.finding: PC, FCI/RFCI, GIES, IDA and adjustment criteria have distinct scopes. GPL >=2, R >=3.5, compiled Rcpp/RcppArmadillo/BH path and graph dependencies.
Ancestral-graph endpoint matrix: entry [i,j] denotes the endpoint at j; 0 absent, 1 circle, 2 arrow, 3 tail. This is not a coefficient or DAG binary adjacency matrix.
IDA requires a linear Gaussian causal model, covariance information and an estimated graph; the target is a total effect.
IDA returns a multiset of possible total effects over compatible DAGs; a multiset is not a confidence interval.
pc requires alpha and indepTest; NAdelete defaults true, m.max infinite; explicit node labels and constraints are inputs.
Stable skeleton is distinguished from orientation rules; acyclicity, sufficient information, Markov and faithfulness assumptions matter.
Orientation order dependence and conservative/majority/conflict options require separate attention; do not infer that stable skeleton fixes every orientation issue.

claims: GIES requires intervention targets and row-to-target indices and returns an interventional essential graph plus a representative.

FCI-JCI context variables encode declared exogeneity/randomized-context assumptions; a calendar label alone supplies none of that truth.

limitations: Bounded four-package extension plus inherited pcalg; broader R temporal coverage remains incomplete.
